data.name: Dayan
data.gender_notes: Dayan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who is steadfast, reliable, and trustworthy. A helper, supporter, or assistant. In Islamic tradition, Dayan is the name of a prophet who assisted the Prophet Solomon in ruling his kingdom. The name Dayan carries the meaning “Faithful, Helper, Supportive” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English, Indonesian. Parents who choose Dayan usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful, helper, supportive and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are strong in faith and are always ready to help others.
data.etymology: Dayan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful, Helper, Supportive.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dayan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: ديان
in_arabic.meaning: الله هو ديان العباد يقتص لهم يوم القيامة
in_arabic.long_meaning: ديان هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الذي يقتص للعباد يوم القيامة، ويحكم بينهم بالعدل، وهو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، قال تعالى: 'وَيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ وَيَحْكُمُ مَن لَّهُ الْحُكْمُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ'

in_urdu.name: دیان
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ عباد کے درمیان انصاف کرنے والا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: دیان اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ اپنے عباد کے درمیان انصاف کرنے والا ہے، اور یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ ارشاد ربانی ہے: 'وَيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ وَيَحْكُمُ مَن لَّهُ الْحُكْمُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ'

in_hindi.name: दियान
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर न्याय करने वाला है अपने सेवकों के लिए
in_hindi.long_meaning: दियान अल्लाह का एक नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है कि वह अपने सेवकों के लिए न्याय करने वाला है, और यह नाम कुरआन में आया है, जैसा कि पवित्र कुरआन में कहा गया है: 'وَيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ وَيَحْكُمُ مَن لَّهُ الْحُكْمُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ'

in_pashto.name: دیان
in_pashto.meaning: الله د بندګانو تر منځ د قیامت په ورځ انصاف کوونکی دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: دیان د الله تعالی یو نوم دی، چې معنی یې دا ده چې هغه د بندګانو تر منځ د قیامت په ورځ انصاف کوونکی دی، او دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې راغلی دی، لکه څنګه چې فرمايي: 'وَيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ وَيَحْكُمُ مَن لَّهُ الْحُكْمُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ'

in_english.name: Dayan
in_english.meaning: The one who judges and executes justice on the Day of Reckoning
in_english.long_meaning: Dayan is one of the names of Allah, meaning the one who judges and executes justice on the Day of Reckoning. It is derived from the Arabic root 'D-Y-N' which means 'to judge' or 'to execute justice'. This name is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing God's role as the ultimate judge and arbiter on the Day of Judgment.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dayan, which means "helpful" or "assistant" in Arabic, holds significant cultural importance, as it represents the values of loyalty and support. This name was cherished and given to children to inspire them to be steadfast, reliable, and kind beings who contribute positively to their communities. It was also a common name for companions, advisors, and leaders, emphasizing the importance of trust and companionship in society. In some Islamic cultures, the name Dayan is considered a strong, significant name for a baby boy, evoking positive feelings of trustworthiness and supportiveness.
data.spiritual_significance: The Islamic name Dayan carries great spiritual significance, as it reflects the prophetic tradition of Prophet Solomon and his companion Prophet Dayan. Prophet Dayan was known for his unwavering support and loyalty to Prophet Solomon, helping him rule his kingdom wisely and justly. This name is a reminder of the importance of compassion, support, and loyalty in one's spiritual journey. By giving this name to a child, parents instill the values of empathy, loyalty, trustworthiness, and reliability, inspiring them to be helpers and supporters of others throughout their lives. It also signifies the presence of a loving and compassionate companion or caretaker in one's life, referencing the spiritual relevance of prophetic companionship and support.
